outline: 本課主旨在培養學生職場英語文溝通能力，如提案、企劃案提寫、時事討論、公司產品行銷、書信寫作，希冀能夠藉由本課程之修習，加強學生進入職場前的競爭力。
schedule:
Week 1: Orientation
Week 2: Conversation topics / Self-introductions
Week 3: Presenting information (1)
Week 4: Presenting information (2)
Week 5: Meetings and discussions (1)
Week 6: Meetings and discussions (2)
Week 7: Review
Week 8: Course project preparation
Week 9: Course project Due
Week 10: Asking for information
Week 11: Writing emails
Week 12: Telephoning
Week 13: Review
Week 14: Reading and writing a resume
Week 15: Being interviewed
Week 16: Responding to feedback
Week 17: Review
Week 18: Final Exam
assessment:
1. Attendance and Participation: 20%
2. Oral and Written Homework: 40 %
3. Course Project: 20%
4. Final Exam: 20%
